entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Demigod of Theros who originated as a human.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Parun of the Boros Legion, considered a demigod but actually a powerful archangel.

entities.name: The Seer's Parables
entities.description: Epic poem of Shadowmoor telling the legends of the demigods.

entities.name: Divinity of Pride
entities.description: Demigod who was the kithkin seer in The Seer's Parables and answered the kithkin's question, driving him insane.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Revered as a demigod by the goblins on Ulgrotha.

events.summary: In the Omens section of The Seer's Parables, the seer shed her skin, revealed herself as the Divinity of Pride, and answered the kithkin's question, driving him insane.
events.quote: the Kithkin seer sheds her skin to reveal that she is not a Kithkin at all

relations.quote: Razia , the parun of the Boros Legion
